hint_ladder.title: Meaning
hint_ladder.text: Diligent means showing care and persistent effort. Halimbawa, masipag at maingat sa trabaho.

hint_ladder.title: Synonym
hint_ladder.text: The best synonym is 'Hardworking'—a diligent person works with dedication and thoroughness.

hint_ladder.title: Antonym Trap
hint_ladder.text: Options A (Lazy), C (Careless), D (Negligent) are all opposites. The question asks for synonym, not antonym.

hint_ladder.title: Tamang Sagot
hint_ladder.text: Option B is correct. Hardworking is the exact synonym of diligent. Tandaan: Diligent = Hardworking.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'Lazy' is an antonym, not a synonym. Trap: synonym_antonym_inversion.

B.text: Correct. Hardworking is the direct synonym of diligent.

next_time_rule: Key Takeaway: Diligent = Hardworking. Mnemonic: 'Dili-gent' parang 'hindi tamad' — so masipag!
deconstruct_text:
**Watch-Out Zone: synonym_antonym_inversion** – Lahat ng distractor ay antonym.

Sa barangay, kapag si Ate Liza ay naghahanda ng listahan ng beneficiaries, inuulit niyang basahin ang bawat pangalan para siguradong walang mali. 'Yan ang diligent — masipag at maingat sa trabaho. Kaya ang synonym ay 'Hardworking'.

Pero 'yong Lazy, Careless, at Negligent, mga katangian 'yan ng tamad at pabaya. Kaya ingat: ang hinahanap ay SYNONYM, hindi ANTONYM. Kaya B ang sagot.
